title: Pro Mobile Manipulator Robot
description: The TIAGO Pro is uniquely suited for our research requirements due to these exclusive technical specifications: 1. Dual 7-DoF Series Elastic Actuator (SEA) Arms • Only commercially available mobile manipulator with dual SEA arms Page 2 of 4 • Critical for safe human-robot interaction research • Essential for complex manipulation tasks requiring two arms • 3kg payload per arm with 96cm reach 2. Integrated Research Platform • Complete ROS2 integration with open-source architecture • Real-time control at 1KHz via EtherCAT bus • Full MoveIt2 integration for motion planning • Native compatibility with NVIDIA Isaac Sim 3. Advanced Sensing Capabilities • 360-degree LIDAR coverage with dual sensors • Integrated RGB-D camera in pan-tilt head • Force feedback through SEA arms • Allegro hand for SEA arm 4-Fingers Humanoid Hand • 4-microphone array for audio interaction 4. Mobile Platform Specifications • Omnidirectional movement through Mecanum wheels • 1.5 m/s speed in all directions • 8-10 hour autonomy • Compact footprint (50x72cm) with lifting torso 5. Research Software Integration • Complete ROS2 stack with source code access • Native Advanced Navigation capabilities • Built-in simulation environment • Real-time control framework No other commercial robot combines these specific technical features necessary for our research in embodied AI and human-robot interaction. Even though other humanoid platforms exist (like Pepper), they lack the dual-arm manipulation capabilities and force-sensitive interaction required for our research. Boston Dynamics' Spot, while advanced, is a quadruped without manipulation capabilities. Latest humanoid robots in the research news such as Tesla Optimus, Figure 01 and 02, Agility Robotics’ Digit, Unitree G1, PAL’s TALOS, ARI, REEM-C and Sanctuary AI’s Phoenix are either commercially unavailable or in prototype phase and not available for academic research or not including the same innovative features as TIAGO Pro. This combination of features makes the TIAGO Pro uniquely suited for our research goals in embodied AI, adaptive learning, and safe human-robot collaboration, with no currently available alternatives that meet all these critical requirements. title: Adaptor Omegon pentru atasarea unui focuser Crayford 2'' pe un tub optic Skywatcher
description:
Adaptor Omegon 2” pentru focuser Crayford pe tub Skywatcher Acest adaptor Omegon se conectează cu usurintă focuser-ul Omegon pentru la telescopul dvs. newtonian Skywatcher. Dacă vă cumpărati un nou focuser pentru telescopul dvs. trebuie să-l montati în primul rând corect. Care este distanta corectă între găuri? Este bun pentru toate telescoapele sau trebuie găuri noi pentru el. Cu acest adaptor pentru telescope Skywatcher puteți zâmbi , pentru că la aceste lucruri nu mai trebuie să vă gânditi. Adaptor cu orificii de potrivire Acest adaptor de metal robust are deja o perforare precisă. Asezati adaptorul pe tub si fixati-l cu suruburile de la vechiul dvs. focuser. Fără găuri noi si fără suruburi noi - atât de usor nu a fost niciodată. După adaptarea la tub pur si simplu atasati focuser-ul Omegon Crayford - si imediati ati terminat iar telescopul dvs. este gata pentru următoarea noapte de observare. Avantajele pe scurt. placă de bază stabilă pentru Omegon Crayford adaptare usoară la telescoape newtoniene SKYWATCHER , cum ar fi 200/1000mm, 254/1200mm, 300/1500mm găuri potrivite exacte pentru instalare plug and play

title: Oscilloscoop met hoge bandbreedte
description: Aan de VUB B-PHOT werd een elektro-optisch karakteriseringsplatform ontwikkeld voor fotonische IC’s. Deze opstelling ondersteunt experimenten op nieuwe lasers en geïntegreerde systemen zoals multi-golflengte lasers voor telecom, LIDAR en neuromorfe toepassingen. Hoewel de huidige apparatuur diverse elektrische/optische I/O-combinaties ondersteunt in de optische C-band tot 50 GHz — inclusief topklasse afstembare lasers, eenkanaals arbitraire golfvormgenerator, real-time spectrumanalyser en een optische spectrumanalyser met ultrahoge resolutie — blijven beperkingen bestaan in intensiteit-fase (IQ) modulatie en tijdsdomein-acquisitie voor coherent detectie. Dit beperkt onze mogelijkheden om geavanceerde modulatieformaten en dynamische signalen te genereren en te analyseren. Wij vragen daarom een oscilloscoop met 50 GHz bandbreedte als essentiële uitbreiding. Samen met bestaande apparatuur maakt dit de generatie en karakterisatie van complexe optische of elektrische signalen mogelijk, in tijd én frequentie tot 50 GHz. Deze uitbreiding versterkt de bestaande infrastructuur, opent nieuwe onderzoekslijnen, en ondersteunt hands-on training voor studenten en samenwerking met academische en industriële partners.

title: Contracte menor de serveis de provisió de dades satel·litàries addicionals del satèl·lit Menut
description: L’objecte del contracte el constitueix els serveis de provisió de dades satel·litàries de les 22 localitzacions geogràfiques (22 captures d’imatge) que consten en l’Annex 1, i segons els arxius en format KML de l’Annex 2, amb una cobertura de nuvolositat menor al 15% i un angle de roll d’entre -15 i +15 graus respecte nadir. Cadascuna de les àrees a capturar és una superfície de 10x10km (100km2 en total). Les dades de les captures s’entregaran en els següents nivells de processat: L0, L1A i L1B, segons les definicions de processat de l’empresa Open Cosmos. L’IEEC podrà acordar una modificació de les localitzacions a capturar que consten dins l’Annex 1 durant l’execució del contracte en cas que la qualitat de les imatges no sigui òptima degut a canvis climatològics.
